title: Prepare owner-approved automatic E2EE enrollment and consented WebRTC desktop controls.
changes: Add first-time browser and AI-client enrollment with a device-local approval dialog, comparison code and encrypted proof before saving a pinned key. Known trusted clients reconnect automatically; device key changes or revoked grants fail closed.

Close pending approval prompts on Cancel, timeouts and lost HTTP responses. Reject replayed enrollment nonces and abort unfinished browser trust transactions; already committed owner grants require explicit device-local revocation.

Preserve owner-bound OS-vault identities across Linux Secret Service, macOS Keychain and Windows DPAPI. Strict E2EE startup waits for the owner vault without rotating established keys or falling back to plaintext tools.

Improve remote desktop quality controls, 480p/720p/1080p profiles, interactive keyboard/mouse/touch/clipboard, responsive fullscreen controls and compact idle previews. Preserve native Stop acknowledgments and block reconnect while a previous Stop is unconfirmed.

Keep real owner approval mandatory. WebRTC media uses DTLS-SRTP rather than an independently verified application-layer E2EE guarantee; external TURN/TLS, signed native media workers and fleet rollout remain separately gated.
